raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

A DP-attention deployment (`--dp N --enable-dp-attention`) is N schedulers with disjoint KV caches, so a gateway that does prefix-aware routing has to pin each request to the rank that holds its prefix. The `X-Data-Parallel-Rank` header is the pinning channel that leaves the request body untouched (no parse/merge/re-serialize on a ~100KB payload), but not every route reads it, and not every route accepts the body field either.

Measured on a live `v0.5.19` server (DeepSeek-V4-Flash, tp4/dp4/ep4), pinning each rank in turn and sampling `num_running_reqs` per rank while the request runs:

| endpoint | body `routed_dp_rank` | body `data_parallel_rank` | header `X-Data-Parallel-Rank` |
|---|:-:|:-:|:-:|
| `/v1/chat/completions` | pins | pins | pins |
| `/v1/completions` | pins | pins | pins |
| `/v1/responses` | **ignored** | **ignored** | **ignored** |
| `/v1/messages` | ignored | ignored | pins |
| `/generate` | pins | pins | **ignored** |

Every "ignored" is an HTTP 200 that round-robins: a pin on those routes fails silently and the request re-prefills cold on another rank.

**Since that measurement**, #35503 landed on `main` and closed the `/v1/responses` row for the first request of a call: `ResponsesRequest` has `routed_dp_rank` (plus the deprecated `data_parallel_rank` alias), and `create_responses` resolves header over body and passes the rank on the `GenerateReqInput`. This PR was rebased on top of it and re-scoped to what is still missing:

- `/generate` does not read the header at all.
- `/v1/messages` (Anthropic) drops a body rank; only the header worked.
- On `/v1/responses`, the continuation turns of a built-in tool loop (`_generate_with_builtin_tools`) are built without the rank, so a pinned conversation leaves its rank after the first tool call.
- Each route had its own copy of the header parsing.

## Modifications

- `request_headers.extract_routed_dp_rank(headers, body_routed_dp_rank)` becomes the single reader of `X-Data-Parallel-Rank` (header over body, 400 on a non-integer header). `OpenAIServingBase.extract_routed_dp_rank_from_header` delegates to it, so chat, completions and responses behave exactly as before.
- `/generate` reads the header through that helper ahead of the env-gated `x-override-*` pass, so precedence matches the OpenAI routes: header over body, `x-override-routed-dp-rank` over both.
- `create_responses`: every continuation `GenerateReqInput` in the built-in tool loop carries `adapted_request.routed_dp_rank`, so a tool loop stays on the rank holding its KV cache.
- `AnthropicMessagesRequest` accepts `routed_dp_rank` (and the deprecated alias) and the converted `ChatCompletionRequest` carries it, so a body pin on `/v1/messages` is honoured too. The header already reached that route through `OpenAIServingChat` and keeps precedence.

No change to `ResponsesRequest` or the `/v1/responses` first-turn path; those are #35503's.

## Live validation

Run on the pre-rebase commit of this branch, cherry-picked onto `v0.5.19` and overlaid on the stock `lmsysorg/sglang:v0.5.19-runtime` image, DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Chat tp2/dp2/ep2, every cell swept across both ranks (the cells this PR exists for four times each):

| endpoint | body `routed_dp_rank` | body `data_parallel_rank` | header `X-Data-Parallel-Rank` |
|---|:-:|:-:|:-:|
| `/v1/chat/completions` | pins | pins | pins |
| `/v1/completions` | pins | pins | pins |
| `/v1/responses` | **pins** | **pins** | **pins** |
| `/v1/messages` | **pins** | **pins** | pins |
| `/generate` | pins | pins | **pins** |

Bold cells were "ignored" on stock v0.5.19. On `main` the `/v1/responses` cells are now covered by #35503; the `/v1/messages` and `/generate` cells are this PR.

## Accuracy Tests

No change to model forward or sampling.

Unit tests (CPU), all passing on the rebased tree:

- `test/registered/cpu/test_request_headers.py` (15 tests): the extractor (no header keeps the body value, case-insensitive header, header over body, non-integer header is a 400) and `/generate` wiring (header pins the rank on the `GenerateReqInput` handed to the tokenizer manager; no header leaves the body rank alone).
- `test/registered/unit/entrypoints/openai/test_responses_protocol.py` (24): adds alias-migrates and `routed_dp_rank`-wins-over-alias next to #35503's `test_pd_routing_fields`.
- `test/registered/unit/entrypoints/openai/test_serving_responses.py` (68): `RoutedDpRankForwardingTestCase`, body rank reaches the `GenerateReqInput`, header overrides body, unpinned stays unpinned.
- `test/registered/unit/entrypoints/anthropic/test_serving.py` (64): body rank and the deprecated alias reach the converted chat request, unpinned stays unpinned.

The existing chat and completions header tests pass against the shared helper.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not applicable: one header lookup per request.

## Rebase note

Rebased onto `main` after #35503 (`/v1/responses` PD routing metadata) and the `/v1/responses` test file's move to `pytest.main`. Conflicts were the overlapping `ResponsesRequest` fields and header extraction, resolved by keeping `main`'s and dropping this PR's copies; the remaining diff is the four items above.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). (No existing page documents the header or `routed_dp_rank`; happy to add one if maintainers want it.)
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed). (Not applicable, see above.)
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

+def extract_routed_dp_rank(
+    headers, body_routed_dp_rank: Optional[int] = None

+class RoutedDpRankForwardingTestCase(unittest.TestCase):
+    """The rank pin must reach the GenerateReqInput, or a DP-aware gateway's
+    pin degrades silently to the engine's own load balancing."""
+
+    def _run(self, request, headers):
+        serving = make_serving()
+        rendered = MessageProcessingResult(
+            prompt="prompt",
+            prompt_ids=[1, 2, 3],
+            image_data=None,
+            audio_data=None,
+            video_data=None,
+            modalities=[],
+            stop=[],
+            reasoning_end_token_ids=[41, 42],
+        )
+        captured = {}
+
+        async def fake_generate(
+            request_id,
+            request_prompt,
+            adapted_request,
+            sampling_params,
+            context,
+            **kwargs,
+        ):
+            captured["adapted_request"] = adapted_request
+            context.append_output(
+                {
+                    "text": "done",
+                    "meta_info": {
+                        "prompt_tokens": 3,
+                        "completion_tokens": 1,
+                        "cached_tokens": 0,
+                    },
+                }
+            )
+            yield context
+
+        serving._generate_with_builtin_tools = fake_generate
+        raw_request = Mock()
+        raw_request.headers = headers
+        with (
+            patch.object(
+                serving, "_apply_conversation_template", return_value=rendered
+            ),
+            patch(
+                "sglang.srt.entrypoints.openai.serving_responses.ReasoningParser"
+            ) as parser_cls,
+        ):
+            parser_cls.return_value.parse_non_stream.return_value = (None, "done")
+            response = asyncio.run(
+                serving.create_responses(request, raw_request=raw_request)
+            )
+        self.assertEqual(response.status, "completed")
+        return captured["adapted_request"]
+
+    def test_body_routed_dp_rank_reaches_engine_request(self):
+        request = ResponsesRequest(
+            model="x", input="hi", request_id="resp_dp", store=False, routed_dp_rank=2
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(self._run(request, {}).routed_dp_rank, 2)
+
+    def test_header_overrides_body(self):
+        request = ResponsesRequest(
+            model="x", input="hi", request_id="resp_dp", store=False, routed_dp_rank=2
+        )
+        adapted = self._run(request, {"x-data-parallel-rank": "3"})
+        self.assertEqual(adapted.routed_dp_rank, 3)
+
+    def test_unpinned_request_stays_unpinned(self):
+        request = ResponsesRequest(
+            model="x", input="hi", request_id="resp_dp", store=False
+        )
